opening.argument: The video prominently advertises a free $1,000 Visa gift card, then directs viewers to click a link and answer a four-question survey. The described steps also ask viewers to submit an email, enter a shipping address, and complete registration to receive the advertised reward. That combination makes the offer a low-barrier route to acquiring personal information in exchange for a promised gift card. The material does not establish who operates the destination, what the survey or registration contains, whether eligibility or fees apply, or whether any card was delivered; those limits do not change what the video itself asks viewers to do.

citations.quote: Summit an email! 3. Enter shipping address! 4. Complete a survey!
